hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.html|*.scss|*.json) (cd apps/web && npx prettier --write "$f") >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac

f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in */db/migration/V*) if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo 'Existing migrations are immutable. Create a new versioned file instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac
